status_classes.DIRECT: Admissible as direct publication evidence for C-SOTA under matched conditions.
status_classes.PENDING: Potentially direct, but one or more qualification gates are not yet demonstrated.
status_classes.CONTEXT: Scientifically relevant but materially different assumptions prevent direct matched ranking.
status_classes.INELIGIBLE: Violates one or more frozen hard problem-domain requirements.

comparators.name: NetworKit DynDijkstra

declared_semantics.source_model: one fixed source per DynDijkstra instance
declared_semantics.notes: PR58 executed the pinned implementation under directed nonnegative mixed-weight updates. It passed two targeted directed cases, but produced exact-distance mismatches on the zero-weight/equal-distance case and failed to terminate within 60 seconds on a 32-node randomized mixed-update case. Under frozen contract v1.0 those empirical failures disqualify this pinned implementation from DIRECT use.

mismatches: PR58 zero-weight/equal-distance case: after increasing edge (2,3) from 0 to 2, DynDijkstra reported d(3)=0 and d(4)=1 while fresh Dijkstra reported d(3)=1 and d(4)=2.
PR58 zero-weight/equal-distance case later diverged on five nodes after increasing edge (0,2) from 0 to 3, including source-side distances becoming effectively infinite.
PR58 randomized directed mixed case timed out after 60 seconds during step 16, an increase of edge (24,25) from 2 to 6.
Because exact answers and terminating online mixed-update processing are frozen hard requirements, later adapter/memory/timing gates were not pursued for this pinned implementation.

comparators.name: Felipe Soares Ramalingam-Reps implementation

declared_semantics.source_model: supplied implementation/driver is fixed to source vertex 0
declared_semantics.update_api: rr_add_edge and rr_remove_edge; no native weight-change API
declared_semantics.notes: Executable implementation rediscovered during PR59 recursion. A weight change may be representable as remove+add, but that composition, exactness, zero-weight behavior, arbitrary-source adaptation, memory accounting and timing have not been qualified. The external algorithm must not be rewritten merely to force eligibility.

blockers: The supplied implementation is fixed-source at vertex 0; a non-invasive arbitrary-source policy is not yet qualified.
The public API exposes edge insertion/removal rather than native weight-change events; remove+add equivalence must be tested rather than assumed.
The implementation uses int costs and has not been qualified against the ADES campaign weight domain or zero-weight adversarial cases.
No canonical PR42 adapter, independent oracle evidence, PR43 accounting, or PR44 timing integration exists yet.

declared_semantics.source_model: arbitrary source; a fresh Boost.Graph Dijkstra run is executed for each query
declared_semantics.query_output: single-source exact distances; point target read from the fresh run
declared_semantics.update_api: edge weights are mutated online in arrival order; no shortest-path state is retained across updates
declared_semantics.notes: External exact recomputation baseline, not a dynamic-maintenance algorithm. Pinned Boost 1.92.0 semantic preflight passed 132 mixed updates (70 increases, 62 decreases) and 414 arbitrary-source Bellman-Ford oracle checks with zero mismatches. The full adapter then replayed canonical PR42 traces on both committed NY graph variants, matched ADES_ORACLE_V2 exactly, enforced a 1-byte PR43 persistent-state budget with zero accounted adaptive state, and reported PR44-compatible timing boundaries.
